_doc: Central policy for the AI Control Layer. Single source of truth, hot-reloaded on every request (edit and save, no restart). Invalid edits are rejected and the last good policy stays active. Removing a control or setting enabled=false turns it off. action: block | redact | flag (log only) | approve (human). mode: enforce | monitor (shadow mode: nothing is blocked, everything that would be is logged).

models._doc: Allowed LLMs for the llm_complete tool. Paid models are budgeted in USD, local models in compute time.

budgets._doc: Per session (one agent run). Any limit hit = DENY with guardrail 'budget'.

obfuscation._doc: Deterministic. Hidden/non-ASCII characters in tool names (zero-width, homoglyphs).

tool_authz._doc: Deterministic. Tool allowlist with risk levels; unknown tools are denied (fail-closed). action=block on a tool forbids it for agents.

loop_detection._doc: Deterministic. Same tool+args repeated more than N times = runaway agent.

payments._doc: Deterministic business rules for transfer_funds. approval_over = four-eyes threshold.

sql_guard._doc: Deterministic. Blocks destructive and stacked SQL (comments stripped first).

egress._doc: Deterministic. Destinations (email domain / URL host) data may leave to.

secrets._doc: Deterministic. API keys, AWS keys, private keys, password= in inputs (block or redact before the tool sees them) and outputs (always redacted).

pii._doc: Deterministic. email, card_number (Luhn), pesel (checksum), iban. Inputs checked on egress tools only; outputs redacted for redact_output tools, or all tools if output_scope=all.

attack_signatures._doc: Deterministic, externally managed feed of historical AI-infrastructure exploits (file path or http(s) URL, reloaded on change). Calls matching a signature at or above min_severity are blocked.

prompt_injection._doc: Semantic (AI-based). Scores prompts and tool outputs 0..1. backend: auto (Ollama if reachable, else heuristic) | ollama | heuristic. threshold = adherence level (lower = stricter). on_detect: taint (later high-risk calls need a human) | block.
